title: Prediction of Pelvic Organ Prolapse Postsurgical Outcome Using Biomaterial-Induced Blood Cytokine Levels: Machine Learning Approach.
summary: Machine learning on biomaterial-induced blood cytokine levels predicted postoperative mesh exposure after pelvic-organ-prolapse surgery, a specific postoperative outcome. AI role: Machine-learning prediction using biomaterial-induced blood cytokines. The article appeared in JMIR Perioperative Medicine.
